utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane — happy to help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m usually the late one, so I just need to know what time you’re leaving and whether there’s still a seat for me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m leaving at 7:20, and yes — there’s still a seat for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — what time do you need the carpool, and where should I pick you up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I need it around 8:15 AM, and you can pick me up at 24 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll pick you up at 24 Maple Street around 8:15 AM.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the carpool supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Cleo. I’ll try to remember to check the list before tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll check the supplies tonight and let you know if we need anything before tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the carpool, Pia. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m just trying to make sure the timing works for everyone. Could we do around 8:15?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 8:15 should work for me. I can be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yep, I think so — I just need to double-check with the other folks and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you text me by tonight if it changes?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Gus, I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow—same pickup time, I think. I’ll double-check and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Tess—thanks for checking. I’ll be ready at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Gus—I’ll swing by if I hear any changes, but for now let’s stick with the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal — I’m setting up the carpool now, and you’re absolutely welcome to join. Want me to save you a seat?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — please save me a seat. I’m in for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down. I’ll send the pickup details soon!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times do you need covered?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam — can you confirm whether you’re available weekdays, and which morning or afternoon times you can cover?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m available on weekdays, and I can usually cover morning drop-off and afternoon pickup. If you tell me the exact times, I’ll confirm what works best.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo — I can help organize the carpool. Let me know who’s riding and what times we’re aiming for, and I’ll keep it tidy.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send the riders and pickup times soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — send them over whenever you’re ready, and I’ll get everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll remind everyone about the carpool and keep the timing straight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. Just keep me posted if anything changes, and I’ll be ready on time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep everyone in the loop and make sure the timing stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the carpool. I’m sorry, I lost the thread there; can you remind me what time we were planning?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It was around 7:30, if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, 7:30 should work for me. Thanks for reminding me — I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help coordinate the carpool—who’s riding, and what time should we plan for?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great — I think it’s me, Sam, and Lena, and we should aim for 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll plan for 7:30 with you, Sam, and Lena. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll adjust it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m putting together the carpool and wanted to see if you want a spot—more the merrier. I can send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m in—send me the details and I’ll hop in when I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, I’ll send them over right now—thanks for jumping in! If your schedule changes, just let me know and I’ll keep the spot open.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Could you handle Tuesday and Thursday pickups this week, and I’ll cover the other days?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I can take Tuesday and Thursday pickups this week.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do the afternoon pickup if that still helps—what time does school let out today?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That still helps a lot—school gets out at 3:15 today. I can meet you by the front loop if that works.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I can be there by 3:15 and meet you at the front loop. Thanks for making it easy!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I’m happy to help coordinate the carpool—what time are you thinking, and who’s riding?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I’m thinking around 8:15, and it looks like it’ll be you, me, and Sam. I’ll confirm the final count and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — 8:15 works for me, and I’ll keep an eye out for your final count. If Sam’s in, we’re set; just send any updates my way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What time are you thinking, and do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I’m thinking around 7:30, and if you could just have the seats clear, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll make sure the seats are cleared and I’ll be ready around 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the carpool locations—where should I pick everyone up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’d start at the north end of the block, then swing by the community center and finish near Maple Street. If you want, I can write the stops in order for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds perfect—please write the stops in order for me, and I’ll start at the north end of the block.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — I think so, but let me double-check the time and pickup details before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—I’m happy to help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you take Thursday’s pickup and let me know if you need the child seat?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can do Thursday’s pickup, and yes, I’ll need the child seat.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Noah, have you heard if the carpool schedule got set yet? I’ve only gotten bits and pieces, so I’m trying to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I might’ve missed that part—did they set it already? I’m a little behind on the carpool chatter.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not sure yet — I’ve just been hearing little updates too. If I hear anything concrete, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely still on for the carpool, Tess?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, we’re still on for the carpool — I’ll be ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just wanted to confirm. I’ll swing by at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow—same pickup time, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, same time is fine. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks—see you then. I’ll let the others know it’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool—sorry, I was just thinking about something else. What time were we saying to leave?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I think we said 7:30. Want me to swing by a few minutes early?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that’d be great — come by a few minutes early if you can. I’ll be ready and waiting out front.
